text:
Iris: Brainstorm: compact "fallback inspector" popup for rollouts — shows trigger, suggested action, and a "simulate" switch. Prototype: https://figma.com/proto/fallback-inspector-compact
Dmitri: Simulation toggle is key. We should show projected token delta and expected error reduction band (low/med/high).
Maya: Agree. Also need guardrails: if simulate shows token delta > org_quota_threshold, block direct redirect and require confirmation modal with org-admin approval.
Tomas: Telemetry requirement: emit `fallback_inspector_event` with decision_id, route, trigger_type, suggested_action, simulated_token_delta, operator, mode. Add header `X-Fallback-Decision` when action applied.
alert-bot: alert-bot: new alert: route "chat/stream" hit p95 latency spike 1.2s > threshold
Iris: UX question: when operator clicks "apply simulated config" do we run a dry-run in a shadow path for 60s and show metrics? Or just a projection?
Dmitri: Run a shadow dry-run (no traffic change) for 60s to collect real data. If data aligns with projection, allow a single-click apply. Otherwise show discrepancy warning.
Maya: Add RBAC: junior oncall can simulate + propose; senior can apply; admins can bypass quota block. Log free-text reason for any apply.
Tomas: I'll draft proto and a small BigQuery export. Also add a sampled trace flag `fallback_sample=true` for joined traces.
Iris: Cool. I'll sketch the inspector flow with the simulate/compare/confirm steps and add a small cost preview.
